text.en:
The Presidential Complaints and Action
Office is hereby renamed as Presidential Action Center,
hereinafter referred to as the Action Center.
This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 5th day of February, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety-one.
By the President:
OSCAR M. ORBOS
Executive Secretary
